Please try again."); } }; return ( <> {/* ✅ added banner */}

The Procedure

We appreciate your interest in us! We believe in quality rather than just quantity and subscribe to good companionship, virtue & nurturing environment for making creative and street smart kids.

Regarding admission & withdrawal:
The Principal reserves the rights to refuse admission to anybody without furnishing any reason.
Parent would have to deposit all the required documents and admission fees within a week of passing the admission test.
Other documents like birth certificate, T.C. have to be submitted within one month after the admission.
In case the student stops attending school without prior information, his/her name will be struck off the school rolls after 15 continuous days of absence. Re-admission will be granted only after seeking written permission from the principal by depositing Rs. 1000/- as re-admission fees.

  • Up to 6 Km – ₹950/month

  • Up to 10 Km – ₹1450/month

Instructions for Payment of Fee

  • Advance fee on Half yearly basis accepted with rebate of 3%.
  • Advance fee on Annual basis accepted with rebate of 7%.
  • Fees to be paid by 15th of every month.
  • Fine ₹50 after due date, name struck off after 3 months.
  • Fees can be paid online via NEFT.
